title: Grammy-winning Artist, Future Celebrates Monumental Year with “One Big Party Tour”
htmlContent:
No one had a bigger year than 2023’s 6x Grammy-nominated artist, Future.  The Atlanta natives, “Wait For You,” had the highest-selling album in 2022.  Future is the only artist to chart a song every week in 2022. He was Variety Magazine’s Collaborator of the year for his work with artists such as Tems, Lil Baby, Drake, and more. “I Never Liked You” surpassed one billion Spotify streams. His non-profit foundation, Freewishes, was recognized as one of the country’s leading philanthropic organizations, servicing the youth, senior citizen community, and needy families.  There is so much to celebrate and be thankful for. So Future is doing just that. Last month, the hip-hop icon revealed he was embarking on a 6-city national tour and celebration entitled “One Big Party Tour.”

Video Credit : @abesi214 youtube / freebandz

“I’m ready to bring one big party to you,” Future stated. He credits his fans for his success and motivation and is eager to share special moments with them on tour, saying, “It’s the unconditional love from my fans that keeps me going. I can’t wait to see you.”

 The tour will stop in Atlanta this Saturday January 14th at the State Farm Arena.  It is being presented by AG Entertainment and Mammoth Inc.  Future will perform alongside hometown popular acts in each city. The Freebandz president not only called on the talents of his A-list friends – Kodak Black, Trippie Redd, Lil Durk, Polo G, and Jeezy – but he also wanted to shine a light on a few popular and promising newcomers in hip-hop, such as Est-Gee, Babyface Ray, Lil Jairmy, Double 00 and Ocean x Kungfu to name a few. His 

The six-city tour kicked off this month (Jan 7) in Houston at the Toyota Center, making landfall across the U.S. in Charlotte tonight, then Atlanta, Chicago, and Washington, D.C., before wrapping up in Boston’s TD Garden (Jan 27). 

Unlike any other tour, One Big Party provides newer artists with the opportunity of a lifetime. “Freebandz Music is global and expanding,” shares Freebandz Executive, Casino.  “Still, we believe in up-and-coming artists and want to allow them to shine.” To purchase tickets: https://onebigpartytour.com
